_doc: Direction-aware feedstock utilisation gating (fix #3). A genome can USE a feedstock only if it encodes an uptake/activation route in the CONSUMING direction. 'uptake' KOs are strong evidence of assimilation; 'overflow_ambiguous' KOs run both ways and are NOT proof of growth on the feedstock (e.g. ackA-pta is acetate's OVERFLOW system). Extend by adding compounds.

uptake.note: acetyl-CoA synthetase (ACS): one-step, ~irreversible, high-affinity acetate assimilation

overflow_ambiguous.note: ackA + pta: reversible; this is the acetate OVERFLOW/excretion pathway. Presence is NOT proof of acetate uptake/growth (see Parageobacillus). Counted only as 'overflow_capable'.

uptake.note: methanol dehydrogenase AND a C1 assimilation module (RuMP OR serine cycle). mdh ALONE is not functional methylotrophy.
hexokinase / glucokinase / glucose-PTS: phosphorylation traps glucose for glycolysis
central metabolite; nearly universal. Uptake per se assumed if organism is heterotroph.
